description_en: Queries the parameter settings of a host in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute接口查询专属集群某个主机的参数信息
kebab_example: aliyun cddc describe-dedicated-host-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-34639v1jt4y40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute

parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the **Hosts** page to view the host ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在**主机列表**查看并获取主机ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dedicated cluster in which the host is created. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the **Dedicated Clusters** page to view the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机所属集群的ID。您可以登录云数据库专属集群控制台，在**集群列表**查看并获取专属集群ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id
